symptom: Fix deployed but tester still sees old text (browser/app cache serving stale JS)
check: After any JS/i18n deploy, bump ?v= query param in index.html so clients fetch fresh file
fix_hint: sed v=N to v=N+1 in index.html script src, redeploy index.html

symptom: Trip plans must ALWAYS be organized: day-by-day, each stop with time + address + one-line info. Hours/addresses only from verified knowledge, never invented.
check: User standing order 2026-10-23: plans follow the intake (destination/days/people) then organized output. Spot-check plan answers for structure.
fix_hint: ORGANIZED PLAN RULE in assistant.php system prompt; verify via test plan request

symptom: Intermittent CDN connection drops (IncompleteRead / remote end closed) cause FALSE check failures even though the live app is healthy — failures move between checks on each run
check: Checker must retry transient transport errors (up to 3 attempts) before marking a check failed; a single failed attempt is not a bug
fix_hint: Retry wrapper in http_get/http_post_json (added 2026-10-24); only fail a check after 3 consecutive transport errors

symptom: Deploy is live on the server but returning visitors (and Cyrus) keep seeing the OLD page — new features invisible, plans showed as raw text. Cause: sw.js service worker was CACHE-FIRST for pages (vta-shell-v23), so the cached page won forever.
check: After ANY frontend deploy: the live sw.js must be network-first for pages (fetch handler branches on request.mode === 'navigate') and the cache version must be bumped (vta-shell-v24+). Verify as a RETURNING visitor (a browser that already has the old service worker), never by a fresh fetch alone.
fix_hint: sw.js: network-first for HTML/navigations, cache only as offline fallback; bump CACHE name every shell change; skipWaiting + clients.claim stay on.

symptom: All API/text double-checks PASSED while the customer actually saw plain raw markdown — no table, no bold, links not clickable. Raw-text verification is NOT product verification.
check: Every deploy/fix must be verified by LOOKING at the rendered page (screenshot/eyes): plan table cards visible, place names bold gold, click opens Google Maps, buttons present. A green API check alone never counts as 'works'.
fix_hint: Visual check step is mandatory in the deploy flow; report only what was SEEN.

symptom: App chat moved from PHP api/assistant.php to the Python backend (Vercel: cyrus-tour-guide-api.vercel.app) on 2026-10-25; checks that still POST to assistant.php test the retired fallback, not the product.
check: All chat checks target POST https://cyrus-tour-guide-api.vercel.app/api/chat with the X-App-Key header (key in hidden_files/.app-key, never in this file or the public repo).
fix_hint: api_post() helper in tour_super_robot.py; assistant.php stays only as an emergency fallback.

symptom: The app chat must always have voice: a mic button (speak your question) and a read-aloud toggle (answers spoken). The Android app needs the RECORD_AUDIO permission or the mic can never work inside the app.
check: Live page must contain vta-chat-mic + vta-voice-toggle; Android manifest must declare RECORD_AUDIO (app v1.0.2+).
fix_hint: Web Speech API in index.html (feature-detected, cannot break chat); RECORD_AUDIO + uses-feature microphone required=false in AndroidManifest.xml.

symptom: Cyrus's standing order: the super robot keeps the app ALWAYS UPDATED — a stale page, stale service worker or old live version is itself a bug, even if nothing 'crashed'.
check: Daily run: compare the live page + sw.js against the newest work copies; if the live version is behind, flag it the same day and push the update through the normal deploy flow (cyrus verifies + deploys).
fix_hint: service-worker + live-page-features checks in the daily run; never let a deploy sit unshipped.
